body_core.spirit:
Part of Spirit — the deliberate half of the life.

An Arabic lot calculated from the Sun, the Moon and the Ascendant, and reversed by sect exactly as Fortune is - the two are mirror images across the rising degree. Where Fortune marks what arrives of its own accord, Spirit marks what you set in motion: intent, chosen work, the mind turned outward into action. Fortune is the hand you were dealt; Spirit is how you decide to play it, and the tradition treats the second as the one you are answerable for.

planet_sign.spirit_aquarius:
You choose the path nobody has laid, on purpose.

Intent is exercised through independence and reform, so the work itself is defined partly by what it refuses. It produces genuine originality and a lifelong argument with the obvious route.
planet_sign.spirit_aries:
You decide by starting, and think the plan through afterwards.

Deliberate action takes an impatient, initiating form here, so intent turns into movement almost before it is examined. It makes you effective at beginnings and repeatedly committed to things you had not finished considering.
planet_sign.spirit_cancer:
You act on behalf of what you are protecting.

Purpose is organised around care and belonging, so the chosen work is undertaken for someone rather than for its own sake. It gives enormous staying power and makes it hard to pursue anything that serves only you.
planet_sign.spirit_capricorn:
Your intent is structural, long-dated and entirely serious.

Deliberate action expresses itself through building something that will still stand, so what you undertake is measured in decades. Early results disappoint and late ones rarely do.
planet_sign.spirit_gemini:
Your intent arrives as words before it arrives as anything else.

Deliberate action runs through talking, writing, asking and connecting, so a plan becomes real to you at the point where you can explain it. The risk is mistaking the articulation for the doing.
planet_sign.spirit_leo:
You mean to be the author of it, not merely part of it.

Intent is expressed through creative authorship and visible ownership, so the work chosen has your signature on it. Anonymous contribution is possible here and never satisfying for long.
planet_sign.spirit_libra:
You choose in relation to someone, never purely alone.

Purpose is exercised through balance, negotiation and the consideration of another position, so the route taken is arrived at jointly. It makes for fair decisions and for a real difficulty in acting before the other party has spoken.
planet_sign.spirit_pisces:
Your purpose is felt before it can be stated.

Deliberate action here runs through imagination, compassion and a sense of what is called for rather than what is planned. The direction is real; committing it to a schedule is the part that has to be learned.
planet_sign.spirit_sagittarius:
You act toward a meaning rather than toward a target.

Purpose is philosophical and expansive, so the chosen direction is justified by what it stands for as much as by what it produces. It carries you a long way and makes the ordinary next step easy to skip.
planet_sign.spirit_scorpio:
Whatever you set out to do, you intend to do completely.

Intent runs deep and undivided, so the work you take on involves investigation, control, or the transformation of something that was hidden. Half-measures are not available to you, which is a strength until the thing was not worth all of it.
planet_sign.spirit_taurus:
What you set out to build, you intend to keep.

Purpose expresses itself through steadiness and material result, so the chosen path is slow to select and very hard to divert once selected. Nothing here is done for the gesture; it is done because you mean to still have it later.
planet_sign.spirit_virgo:
Your purpose expresses itself as craft rather than as ambition.

Deliberate action is analytical, corrective and detailed, so intent turns into method and the method is where the meaning lives. The chosen life is one of getting a specific thing genuinely right.

planet_house.spirit_1:
Your purpose and your person are the same project.

Spirit falls in the house of the self, so what you intend is visible in how you carry yourself and pursuing it is inseparable from becoming who you are. There is no version of this life where the work is kept at arm's length.
planet_house.spirit_10:
Your purpose and your public standing are the same thing.

Spirit at the career point makes chosen action visible and reputational, so vocation is not what pays for the life but what the life is for. This is the most straightforwardly ambitious placement the lot can take.
planet_house.spirit_11:
You pursue your purpose through the group rather than the self.

Spirit in the house of friendship and collective hope directs intent toward networks, causes and shared projects. What you have chosen is achieved by assembling people, and that assembling is the skill.
planet_house.spirit_12:
Your purpose is worked out in private, and mostly unwitnessed.

Spirit in the twelfth turns deliberate action inward - toward retreat, research, the unconscious, or service that leaves no public trace. It is not a thwarted placement, but it will never look like achievement from outside.
planet_house.spirit_2:
You pursue your purpose by making it pay for itself.

Spirit in the house of resources ties chosen action to earnings, skill and what you own outright. The work is real to you at the point where it supports you, and independence is the form ambition takes.
planet_house.spirit_3:
Your purpose is exercised through speaking, writing and the near at hand.

Spirit in the house of communication turns intent into conversation, correspondence, teaching and the daily traffic of ideas. Big plans get executed in small, local, verbal increments.
planet_house.spirit_4:
What you mean to do is done for the sake of home.

Spirit at the chart's base makes family, roots and the private foundation the object of deliberate action. The public may never see the work; that is not where its point lies.
planet_house.spirit_5:
You act on purpose through what you create.

Spirit in the house of creativity turns intent into performance, play, children or the made thing. The chosen work must be enjoyable in the doing or it will not be sustained, and that is a requirement rather than an indulgence.
planet_house.spirit_6:
Your purpose lives in the daily work rather than above it.

Spirit in the house of service and routine puts deliberate action into craft, health and the tasks that recur. It is an unglamorous placement that produces genuine competence and quiet usefulness.
planet_house.spirit_7:
You pursue your purpose through partnership, or not at all.

Spirit in the house of the other makes chosen action collaborative: the work takes shape opposite someone, in contract, marriage or alliance. Working alone is possible and consistently less effective.
planet_house.spirit_8:
Your intent is aimed at what is shared, hidden or has to be transformed.

Spirit in the eighth turns deliberate action toward other people's resources, deep research, crisis and the things nobody wants to look at. The work is serious and rarely visible from outside.
planet_house.spirit_9:
You act in service of a belief you can articulate.

Spirit in the house of meaning turns intent toward teaching, travel, law or philosophy, so the path selected needs a rationale larger than itself. Given one, you will go a very long way with it.

aspects.spirit_conjunction_ascendant:
Your purpose is legible in how you arrive.

This lot falls on the rising degree, so intent is part of the first impression and people read you as someone going somewhere. Very little of what you mean to do stays private.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_ceres:
You act in order to provide.

Nurture fuses with deliberate action, so the work you take on is organised around feeding, tending or sustaining somebody. Purpose that serves nobody registers to you as no purpose at all.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_chiron:
Your purpose grows directly out of what hurt you.

The wound sits on this lot, so intent is shaped by injury and the work becomes the way you handle it. Tending others is the usual form and is not a substitute for your own repair.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_descendant:
Your intent takes shape opposite another person.

The lot of chosen action falls on the partnership angle, so purpose is clarified, opposed or carried by whoever you are with. Deciding alone is possible and consistently less accurate.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_eris:
You act in order to expose what is being ignored.

Disruptive truth-telling fuses with intent, so what you undertake involves naming the thing the room agreed not to name. It makes you necessary and rarely comfortable.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_eros:
Desire and purpose run off the same engine.

Erotic vitality occupies deliberate action, so what you want and what you intend are hard to tell apart. The work is pursued with appetite, which sustains it and occasionally distorts it.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_fortune:
What arrives and what you intend land in the same place.

The two lots conjoin, so circumstance and deliberate action reinforce rather than pull against each other, and the opportunities that come are the ones already being worked toward. Unusual, and worth not squandering.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_hygiea:
Your intent is to keep the system well.

Preventative care fuses with chosen action, so purpose runs toward health, maintenance and the quiet avoidance of crisis. Nobody notices work that stops things going wrong; it is still the work.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_ic:
Your purpose is pursued from home, and for it.

The lot of chosen action sits at the chart's base, so intent is rooted in family, privacy and the place you live. The world may never see the work; it was not aimed there.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_juno:
What you have chosen is undertaken with someone, by agreement.

Commitment fuses with intent, so the route taken is contractual and the partnership is part of the work rather than beside it. Terms matter to you more than others understand.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_jupiter:
Your purpose is larger than your circumstances, and always has been.

Expansion fuses with intent, so the chosen direction runs ambitious, meaning-led and inclined to outrun its resources. Scale is the gift and the recurring correction.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_lilith:
Your purpose includes refusing what you were told to want.

The disowned occupies this lot, so intent is tied to autonomy, appetite and the parts of you that decline to be made convenient. Compliance costs you the purpose itself.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_mars:
Intent and force arrive together, with no gap between deciding and moving.

Drive occupies the will, giving unusual initiative and very little patience for the deliberating phase. You are the one who has already started.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_mc:
What you intend is what you are publicly known for.

The purpose-point falls at the career point, so purpose and reputation are the same object. Work that cannot be seen will not satisfy this, whatever else it pays.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_mercury:
Thinking and doing are one motion here.

The reasoning mind sits on this lot, so plans, speech and writing are the form your purpose takes. This is the most literal reading the lot can have.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_moon:
You act on what you feel, and the feeling is usually right.

Instinct fuses with chosen action, so intent is emotionally sourced rather than reasoned into place. It makes for conviction, and for decisions that are hard to justify afterwards.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_neptune:
You are certain of the direction long before you can describe it.

Imagination occupies the lot, so purpose is intuited, artistic or devotional and resists being written down. The vision is genuine; the plan is the missing half.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_nessus:
You act to break a cycle that predates you.

Inherited harm occupies the solar lot, so the work itself is bound up with ending a pattern rather than passing it on. The purpose is real and the material is heavy.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_north_node:
What you intend and what you are here to grow into are one direction.

The evolutionary path occupies the will, so deliberate effort and soul-development point the same way. Rare, and it makes the unfamiliar road the obvious one.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_pallas:
Your intent expresses itself as strategy.

Pattern recognition occupies the purpose-point, so purpose takes the form of a plan, a design, or a problem solved cleanly. You are most deliberate when there is a board to read.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_pholus:
Small deliberate acts of yours set off disproportionate consequences.

Catalysis fuses with intent, so a minor decision taken on purpose reliably becomes the hinge of something far larger. Choose the small things carefully; they are not small.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_pluto:
Whatever you mean to do, you intend to change it at the root.

Transformative force fuses with deliberate action, so the chosen work is total, investigative and usually about power. Nothing partial holds your attention.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_saturn:
What you set out to do, you intend to still be doing in thirty years.

Discipline holds this lot, so purpose is serious, slow and structural. Early progress is unrewarding and the late return is disproportionate.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_south_node:
You pursue on purpose what you could already do without thinking.

Inherited skill holds the solar lot, so the task chosen draws on capacities that arrived complete. Effective immediately, and it can stop you ever choosing the harder direction.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_sun:
What you intend and who you are point the same way.

Identity sits on the solar lot, so purpose is less something you find than something you already are. Vocation clarifies early and rarely needs revising.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_uranus:
Your intent is to do it differently, and that is not negotiable.

Disruption fuses with chosen action, so the path is unconventional by design rather than by accident. Real originality, and a chronic inability to take the obvious route.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_venus:
You pursue what you find beautiful and call it a plan.

Taste and value fuse with deliberate action, so the chosen path gets selected by attraction and justified by argument afterwards. Genuine artistry, and a blind spot about the merely pleasant.
aspects.spirit_conjunction_vesta:
Your purpose is a devotion, and it narrows the rest of the life.

Sacred focus occupies chosen action, so intent concentrates to a single flame and everything else is arranged around keeping it lit. Effective, and costly in ordinary pleasures.
aspects.spirit_opposition_ascendant:
Your purpose is visible to everyone but yourself.

The lot of intent sits opposite the rising degree, so others read your direction before you have named it. Their reading is worth asking for.
aspects.spirit_opposition_ceres:
Care arrives as a demand from outside rather than an impulse from within.

Nurture opposes deliberate action, so the obligation to provide is met rather than chosen, and the plan is repeatedly amended around somebody's need.
aspects.spirit_opposition_chiron:
You keep meeting your own wound in the people you work with.

The injury sits opposite chosen action, so the sore place is encountered relationally rather than privately. Healing others is the usual detour; the return trip is the point.
aspects.spirit_opposition_descendant:
You set the direction and others react to it.

Deliberate action is seated on the rising side, so purpose originates with you and partnership arranges itself afterwards. Independent, and occasionally lonelier than intended.
aspects.spirit_opposition_eris:
The disruption to your plans comes from someone else's honesty.

Contrarian force opposes intent, so the uncomfortable truth is delivered to you rather than by you. It is usually correct and rarely welcome.
aspects.spirit_opposition_eros:
Desire arrives from outside and redirects the plan.

Appetite sits opposite chosen action, so what you want is encountered in another person and the purpose bends around it. Powerful, and worth noticing while it happens.
aspects.spirit_opposition_fortune:
What you intend and what arrives sit at opposite ends of the life.

The two lots oppose, so effort and luck operate in different domains and rarely reinforce each other. What you build, you build; what comes, comes elsewhere.
aspects.spirit_opposition_hygiea:
Your body files its objections through other people.

Health sits opposite the will, so the warning to slow down arrives as somebody's concern rather than as your own perception. Take the second-hand warning seriously.
aspects.spirit_opposition_ic:
Your purpose pulls you out of the house.

The lot of chosen action sits at the career point, so intent is exercised in the world rather than at home. Domestic life accommodates the work here, not the other way round.
aspects.spirit_opposition_juno:
Your commitments and your purposes are held by different people.

Partnership opposes chosen action, so the relationship's claims and the aim's demands arrive from opposite directions. Explicit terms serve better here than goodwill.
aspects.spirit_opposition_jupiter:
Your purposes are enlarged by other people's belief in them.

Expansion sits opposite the purpose-point, so scope, patronage and opportunity are conferred rather than generated. It works well, and it makes you dependent on the company you keep.
aspects.spirit_opposition_lilith:
You meet your own refusal in the people who defy you.

The disowned opposes chosen action, so autonomy and appetite are encountered as somebody else's difficulty. Reclaiming them shortens the argument considerably.
aspects.spirit_opposition_mars:
You meet your own drive as other people's aggression.

Force sits opposite chosen action, so conflict arrives from outside and your own assertion is discovered by having to answer it. Owning the drive as yours changes the pattern.
aspects.spirit_opposition_mc:
Your real purpose is pursued away from public view.

The lot of intent sits at the chart's base, so deliberate work happens privately while the career shows something else. The two need not be reconciled, only both acknowledged.
aspects.spirit_opposition_mercury:
Other people put your intentions into words before you do.

Thought sits opposite deliberate action, so purpose becomes articulate through dialogue and argument rather than in private. The right interlocutor is equipment, not a luxury.
aspects.spirit_opposition_moon:
Your feelings show up as objections to your plans.

Instinct opposes chosen action, so the emotional life arrives as counter-argument rather than support. It is information, and treating it as obstruction is how the plans keep failing.
aspects.spirit_opposition_neptune:
Your purpose is clearest when someone else reflects it back.

Vision sits opposite deliberate action, so meaning is met in others, in art or in circumstance rather than generated internally. Alone, the direction blurs.
aspects.spirit_opposition_nessus:
The pattern you are breaking is carried by someone else.

Inherited harm opposes deliberate action, so the toxic cycle is met in a relationship or a family rather than in yourself. Refusing to continue it is the work, and it is done in company.
aspects.spirit_opposition_north_node:
The growth you need runs opposite the direction you chose.

The evolutionary path sits across from the lot, so the deliberate plan and the developmental one point apart. Both are real; the tension between them is the curriculum.
aspects.spirit_opposition_pallas:
Someone else always sees the flaw in the plan first.

Strategy sits opposite the solar lot, so design and critique come from the other side of the table. It sharpens the work and makes solo planning genuinely weaker.
aspects.spirit_opposition_pholus:
Other people's small decisions keep changing your direction.

Catalysis sits opposite this lot, so the hinge moments are triggered externally and arrive without warning. Staying loosely held is more useful than planning harder.
aspects.spirit_opposition_pluto:
You meet power as something other people hold.

Transformative force opposes deliberate action, so control, crisis and intensity arrive from outside and the work you take on is shaped by surviving them. The power becomes yours only once it is claimed.
aspects.spirit_opposition_saturn:
The limits on what you intend appear to come from outside.

Restriction opposes deliberate action, so authority, obligation and refusal are met externally. Working out which of those limits you installed yourself is the long project.
aspects.spirit_opposition_south_node:
Your old competence sits opposite what you are trying to do now.

Inherited skill opposes chosen action, so the practised strength keeps presenting itself as an alternative to the chosen direction. Retiring it deliberately is the move.
aspects.spirit_opposition_sun:
You discover what you intend by watching what you resist.

Identity sits opposite the lot, so purpose is met as something outside you and has to be claimed rather than assumed. Self-definition arrives late and firmly.
aspects.spirit_opposition_uranus:
Disruption arrives from elsewhere and rearranges your plans.

Innovation sits opposite chosen action, so change is encountered rather than initiated and the direction is repeatedly revised by events. Adaptability is not optional here.
aspects.spirit_opposition_venus:
What you want keeps arriving in the shape of another person.

Affection opposes intent, so desire and value are encountered relationally, and the chosen path is repeatedly renegotiated around somebody. Rich, and rarely simple.
aspects.spirit_opposition_vesta:
What you are devoted to and what you intend are not the same altar.

Devotion sits opposite this lot, so focus is claimed by something other than the stated aim. Choosing between them, openly, resolves more than trying to serve both.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_ascendant:
How you present and what you intend are related but never matched.

The rising degree and chosen action sit at an angle, so people consistently misjudge what you are actually pursuing. Correcting the impression is ongoing work.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_ceres:
What people need from you and what the work needs are never the same week.

Care and this lot are awkwardly geared, so providing and pursuing keep arriving out of phase. Scheduling both, explicitly, resolves more than good intentions.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_chiron:
Acting on purpose irritates the wound without ever provoking a crisis.

The injury and chosen action sit awkwardly, so deliberate effort produces a persistent low soreness rather than an identifiable problem to solve. Small accommodations beat waiting it out.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_descendant:
What partners expect of you and what you intend keep diverging.

The partnership angle and chosen action are misaligned, so the people close to you are always working from a slightly outdated version of the plan. Saying the current one aloud is the maintenance.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_eris:
Your timing on the uncomfortable truth is persistently off.

Candour and purpose here keep missing, so the necessary objection arrives too early to be heard or too late to help. The content is right; the moment is the skill.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_eros:
What you want and what you have chosen keep sitting slightly apart.

Desire and deliberate action refuse to align, so appetite is present but pointed just off the aim. Working with the misalignment beats trying to argue it away.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_fortune:
What arrives and what you intended are always slightly the wrong shape for each other.

The two lots refuse to align, so luck delivers material adjacent to the aim and using it means adapting the aim. Converting rather than waiting is the whole method.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_hygiea:
The pace the work wants and the pace the body allows never agree.

Health and the lot are mismatched, so effort and recovery arrive in the wrong order. Continuous small correction is the only method that holds.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_ic:
Home and the work never quite make room for each other.

The base of the chart and deliberate action sit awkwardly, so domestic life and chosen purpose demand continual, unglamorous renegotiation. It does not resolve; it is managed.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_juno:
Your commitment and your direction need adjusting against each other constantly.

Partnership and the will sit at an angle, so the relationship's terms and the aim's demands are perpetually slightly incompatible. Openly renegotiating beats private accounting.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_jupiter:
The opportunity is always adjacent to the one you wanted.

Expansion and chosen action never settle on a scale, so what is offered is near the aim without matching it. Taking the adjacent version repeatedly is how this actually advances.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_lilith:
Your autonomy and your aims chafe without ever openly conflicting.

The disowned and deliberate action are poorly matched, so refusal and purpose grate quietly and neither ever forces the issue. Making the refusal explicit clears more than enduring it.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_mars:
Your effort arrives slightly before or after it was needed.

Drive and deliberate action keep bad time together, so the push comes when patience was called for and stalls when force would have worked. Correctable by observation over years.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_mc:
Your purpose and your professional role require constant reconciling.

The career point and deliberate action will not settle, so the job that advances you and the aim that matters keep pulling at slightly different angles. A working life of small adjustments.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_mercury:
How you describe the plan and what the plan is keep drifting apart.

Thought and chosen action slip past one another, so the account never quite matches the work. Revising the description periodically is the maintenance nobody schedules.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_moon:
Your mood and your plan require continual renegotiation.

Feeling and deliberate action are awkwardly geared, so the direction that suited you last month sits wrong this month. Adjusting as you go beats setting it once and enduring.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_neptune:
A vague dissatisfaction sits inside the work and never resolves into a reason.

Vision and deliberate action are misaligned, so the route taken produces a persistent low disappointment that cannot be named or fixed. Naming it approximately beats waiting for precision.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_nessus:
An old pattern keeps grazing the work without ever fully surfacing.

Inherited harm and chosen action sit at odds, so the damage interferes obliquely and never presents itself plainly enough to confront. Naming it partially is worth more than waiting.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_north_node:
Your chosen direction and your growth direction are subtly out of true.

The evolutionary path and the purpose-point do not align, so deliberate effort advances you at an angle to where you are meant to go. Small course corrections, often.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_pallas:
The strategy and the daily conduct of the work do not match.

Design and deliberate action never mesh, so the plan is sound and the practice follows other rules. Reviewing what actually happened is the correction.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_pholus:
Small choices keep tilting the plan in ways you cannot anticipate.

Catalysis and intent will not synchronise, so trivial decisions produce consequences out of all proportion and never the expected ones. Holding the plan loosely is the adaptation.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_pluto:
How much to control and how much to release requires constant renegotiation.

Power and the solar lot will not line up, so the grip is always slightly too tight or too loose for what the work needs. Uncomfortable, continuous, and manageable.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_saturn:
The standard you are held to keeps shifting under the plan.

Discipline and chosen action are badly matched, so the effort that sufficed last year does not now and the goalposts move unannounced. Continuous recalibration becomes part of the job.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_south_node:
Old habits attach themselves to new purposes and fit badly.

Inherited skill and chosen action are awkwardly geared, so the practised method is applied to work it was not shaped for. Noticing the mismatch is most of the fix.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_sun:
Who you are and the thing you settled on never quite line up.

Identity and intent sit at an unworkable angle, so no chosen path accommodates the whole self and each adjustment reveals a new gap. Several partial fits serve better than one search for the right one.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_uranus:
The need to change and the need to continue never reconcile.

Disruption and deliberate action sit at odds, so restlessness and commitment demand jarring, repeated adjustments. Neither impulse is wrong and neither yields.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_venus:
What appeals to you and what serves the purpose refuse to converge.

Taste and the purpose-point answer to different criteria, so the agreeable option costs the aim and the aim costs the pleasure. Alternating deliberately works; hunting for overlap does not.
aspects.spirit_quincunx_vesta:
Your focus and your aim are never quite pointed at the same thing.

Devotion and chosen action are misaligned, so intensity lands adjacent to the purpose and has to be steered back. The steering is the discipline.
aspects.spirit_sextile_ascendant:
People can tell you are up to something, and it helps.

Chosen action and the rising degree assist each other, so purpose is visible in the manner and that visibility opens doors. Nothing has to be announced.
aspects.spirit_sextile_ceres:
Looking after people fits comfortably inside your ambitions.

Nurture supports deliberate action, so care and purpose reinforce each other and neither has to be sacrificed. It suits work where the two are the same act.
aspects.spirit_sextile_chiron:
What you learned the hard way is usable in what you do next.

The wound cooperates with deliberate action, so injury converts into competence rather than obstructing it. The conversion is available and still has to be made deliberately.
aspects.spirit_sextile_descendant:
Other people are useful to your plans, and you to theirs.

The partnership angle supports the lot, so alliances form easily around what you are aiming at. Collaboration costs you nothing here.
aspects.spirit_sextile_eris:
You can name the uncomfortable thing without wrecking the room.

Disruptive candour supports this lot, so dissent serves the aim rather than blowing it up. It makes you effective where pure diplomacy fails.
aspects.spirit_sextile_eros:
Appetite drives the work without running it.

Desire assists chosen action, so enthusiasm is genuinely available for the things you have decided to do. It keeps long projects alive past the point where duty alone would stop.
aspects.spirit_sextile_fortune:
What comes to you is usefully close to what you were after.

The two lots cooperate, so circumstance keeps handing you material that suits the direction already chosen. Not the same as getting what you want, and better than it sounds.
aspects.spirit_sextile_hygiea:
You look after the machine that does the work.

Preventative care supports intent, so health, rest and maintenance are folded into the plan rather than sacrificed to it. Unremarkable, and it is why you are still going.
aspects.spirit_sextile_ic:
Home supports the work rather than competing with it.

The base of the chart assists intent, so family and private life resource your purposes instead of pulling against them. Quietly load-bearing.
aspects.spirit_sextile_juno:
Your commitments and your ambitions cooperate.

Partnership supports chosen action, so a spouse or ally reinforces the direction rather than competing with it. The support is real and worth acknowledging out loud.
aspects.spirit_sextile_jupiter:
Opportunity tends to appear alongside your intentions.

Expansion assists the purpose-point, so once a direction is set, openings, patrons and useful luck present themselves. Real, and easily mistaken for coincidence.
aspects.spirit_sextile_lilith:
You can refuse without it costing you the plan.

The disowned supports chosen action, so autonomy and appetite serve your purposes instead of undermining them. Saying no is a working tool here, not a rupture.
aspects.spirit_sextile_mars:
You can push a plan forward without forcing it.

Drive supports deliberate action, so initiative is available on demand and applying it does not cost you the room. The difference between energetic and exhausting.
aspects.spirit_sextile_mc:
Your ambitions and your standing advance together.

The career point supports deliberate action, so what you mean to do tends to be the thing that builds a reputation. The two rarely have to be traded against each other.
aspects.spirit_sextile_mercury:
Explaining the plan is how you improve it.

Thought supports intent, so articulation, correspondence and argument sharpen purpose rather than delaying it. An easy asset, and easy to under-use.
aspects.spirit_sextile_moon:
Your instincts are useful advisers to your plans.

Feeling assists deliberate action, so the emotional read and the chosen course tend to agree, and disagreement is worth listening to. It makes deciding less lonely than it is for others.
aspects.spirit_sextile_neptune:
Imagination is a working instrument for you rather than a distraction.

Vision supports chosen action, so intuition and artistry can be pointed at a chosen aim and will cooperate. The dreaming and the doing are on speaking terms.
aspects.spirit_sextile_nessus:
You can handle the ugly material without being contaminated by it.

Inherited harm cooperates with deliberate action, so difficult inheritance becomes something workable instead of something carried. It suits work others cannot stomach.
aspects.spirit_sextile_north_node:
Your plans keep nudging you toward what you are meant to become.

The evolutionary path assists deliberate action, so ordinary decisions tend to move you in the growth direction without heroics. Easy to miss, and genuinely lucky.
aspects.spirit_sextile_pallas:
You see the shape of the problem before you commit to solving it.

Strategic intelligence assists the solar lot, so plans are well designed from the outset and rarely need rescuing. Quietly one of the most useful placements the lot takes.
aspects.spirit_sextile_pholus:
Small moves of yours open doors out of proportion to their size.

Catalysis assists the will, so modest deliberate steps produce disproportionate returns. It rewards acting early and slightly, rather than waiting to act decisively.
aspects.spirit_sextile_pluto:
You can commit completely to something without being consumed by it.

Transformative depth assists chosen action, so intensity is available when the work needs it and recedes when it does not. Considerable staying power, well regulated.
aspects.spirit_sextile_saturn:
You are good at the unglamorous middle of a plan.

Discipline supports intent, so structure, patience and follow-through are available without being extracted. It is the reason your projects finish.
aspects.spirit_sextile_south_node:
Old competence is available to whatever you take on now.

Inherited skill supports the will, so past capability transfers cleanly into whatever is chosen now. The advantage is real; relying on it exclusively is the trap.
aspects.spirit_sextile_sun:
Your sense of self quietly backs whatever you decide to do.

Identity and the lot cooperate, so pursuing a purpose reinforces the person rather than taxing him. Undramatic, and it removes a friction most people carry.
aspects.spirit_sextile_uranus:
You can change the plan without abandoning the purpose.

Innovation assists deliberate action, so improvisation and reform serve the direction instead of derailing it. Adaptable in a way that steadier charts are not.
aspects.spirit_sextile_venus:
What you enjoy and what you are pursuing get along.

Affection assists chosen action, so the work is pleasant, the collaborators are agreeable, and appetite pulls roughly where intent already points. It compounds quietly over years.
aspects.spirit_sextile_vesta:
You can concentrate on purpose, and stop when it is done.

Devotion assists deliberate action, so focus is summonable without becoming the whole personality. Sustainable intensity, which is rarer than the intensity itself.
aspects.spirit_square_ascendant:
How you come across undercuts what you are trying to do.

The rising degree grates on deliberate action, so manner and purpose contradict each other and people misjudge which one to take seriously. Small behavioural adjustments do more here than better arguments.
aspects.spirit_square_ceres:
Looking after people and pursuing your aims keep costing each other.

Care collides with chosen action, so time given to others is taken from the work and the guilt runs in both directions. This one is solved by scheduling, not by resolve.
aspects.spirit_square_chiron:
Acting on purpose reactivates the sense that you are not equal to it.

The wound grates on the will, so every deliberate step presses on inadequacy and success fails to settle it. The way through uses the wound rather than outrunning it.
aspects.spirit_square_descendant:
The people closest to you complicate what you commit to.

The partnership angle cuts across chosen action, so relationships and purpose keep taxing one another. Naming the cost early is worth more than absorbing it silently for years.
aspects.spirit_square_eris:
Your instinct to disrupt keeps undoing your own plans.

Contrarian force collides with chosen action, so the fight gets picked at the moment the aim needed cooperation. The candour is an asset with terrible timing.
aspects.spirit_square_eros:
Wanting something and intending it are not the same, and you keep confusing them.

Desire grates on the will, so appetite hijacks direction and the plan is rewritten around the pull. Naming the want as a want restores the choice.
aspects.spirit_square_fortune:
What arrives is never quite what you were working toward.

The two lots grate, so circumstance keeps offering something adjacent to the aim and taking it means amending the aim. Learning to convert the offered thing beats waiting for the intended one.
aspects.spirit_square_hygiea:
You spend the body to buy the plan.

Health works against deliberate action, so the undertaking is repeatedly funded by rest, food and maintenance you did not have to spare. The debt is always called in eventually.
aspects.spirit_square_ic:
Home and ambition keep making each other impossible.

The base of the chart cuts across intent, so private life and chosen work compete for the same hours and neither yields. The cost tends to be paid at home, quietly.
aspects.spirit_square_juno:
What you have committed to and what you mean to do are in tension.

Partnership grates on deliberate action, so the relationship's terms and the purpose's demands keep obstructing one another. Renegotiating openly beats resenting quietly.
aspects.spirit_square_jupiter:
You commit to more purpose than one life can carry.

Appetite for scale strains deliberate action, so intentions are set larger than any schedule can hold and the shortfall reads as failure. Sizing to capacity is unexciting and it works.
aspects.spirit_square_lilith:
Your refusals keep costing you the thing you were trying to build.

The disowned grates on chosen action, so autonomy asserts itself at precisely the moments compliance would have served the aim. The refusal is usually right and the timing usually is not.
aspects.spirit_square_mars:
Your effort and your aim keep missing each other.

Drive grates on deliberate action, so energy arrives as force rather than direction and gets spent on the wrong obstacle. Aiming before pushing is the whole discipline.
aspects.spirit_square_mc:
What you actually intend and what your career requires are different things.

The career point grates on the solar lot, so professional advancement and genuine purpose keep diverging. Choosing purpose is expensive and usually right.
aspects.spirit_square_mercury:
You talk yourself out of things you had correctly decided.

Analysis works against chosen action, so reasoning arrives after the decision and dismantles it. A deadline on the deliberating is worth more than better arguments.
aspects.spirit_square_moon:
What you want to do and what you can bear to do keep diverging.

Feeling cuts across deliberate action, so the plan is undermined by moods it did not budget for. Building the emotional cost into the plan is the fix nobody enjoys.
aspects.spirit_square_neptune:
Your purpose keeps dissolving the moment you look at it directly.

Vagueness undermines this lot, so direction is felt but not held, and effort disperses into things adjacent to the aim. Writing the aim down, in words, is unglamorous and necessary.
aspects.spirit_square_nessus:
An old pattern keeps attaching itself to whatever you undertake.

Inherited harm cuts across the purpose-point, so what you undertake reproduces a dynamic you did not author. Recognising the shape of it is most of the escape.
aspects.spirit_square_north_node:
What you intend and where you are meant to be heading are at odds.

The growth direction cuts across chosen action, so the plans that feel most yours pull away from the development being asked of you. The tension is the instruction.
aspects.spirit_square_pallas:
Your strategy and your actual conduct do not match.

Planning works against purpose here, so the analysis is sound and the execution follows a different logic entirely. Reviewing what you did, rather than what you planned, is the correction.
aspects.spirit_square_pholus:
Minor decisions of yours keep detonating the larger plan.

Catalysis collides with deliberate action, so a small unconsidered choice repeatedly becomes the thing that changes everything. Slowing down on the trivial is counter-intuitive and correct.
aspects.spirit_square_pluto:
Your intentions get tangled with control.

Power struggles cut across deliberate action, so the chosen work attracts crises of dominance and the plan becomes something to defend. Letting go of the grip usually advances the aim.
aspects.spirit_square_saturn:
Every deliberate step costs more than it should.

Restriction bears on the solar lot, so obstacles, delay and self-doubt attend the direction chosen throughout. It builds real durability at a genuine price.
aspects.spirit_square_south_node:
You keep solving new problems with old competence.

Inherited skill works against deliberate action, so the practised response arrives before the appropriate one and the chosen aim gets served badly by a genuine talent.
aspects.spirit_square_sun:
Who you are keeps arguing with what you decided on.

Identity grates on the purpose-point, so the path selected demands a version of yourself you are not, and the friction forces an honest purpose rather than a convenient one.
aspects.spirit_square_uranus:
You abandon good plans out of restlessness rather than judgement.

Disruption works against chosen action, so the need for novelty keeps overturning a direction that was working. Distinguishing boredom from a real reason is the lifelong task.
aspects.spirit_square_venus:
What is pleasant and what is purposeful pull in different directions.

Taste collides with chosen action, so comfort and charm keep diverting the plan, and the plan keeps costing you comfort. Choosing explicitly each time beats hoping they align.
aspects.spirit_square_vesta:
Your focus keeps landing on something other than the aim.

Devotion cuts across the lot, so intensity is real but misdirected, burning on an adjacent altar. Choosing the flame deliberately is the work behind the work.
aspects.spirit_trine_ascendant:
You look like someone who knows what they are doing, and you do.

The rising degree and the will agree, so purpose is legible in the manner and the manner is accurate. It saves an enormous amount of explaining.
aspects.spirit_trine_ceres:
Providing for others and pursuing your aims are one act.

Nurture flows into deliberate action, so care is built into the work rather than subtracted from it. It makes a whole life out of what is usually two competing ones.
aspects.spirit_trine_chiron:
What you have suffered has become something you can use.

The wound and intent are at ease, so hard-won knowledge converts into purpose without residue. People bring you their difficulty because it plainly does not frighten you.
aspects.spirit_trine_descendant:
People take up your purposes readily.

The partnership angle flows into deliberate action, so allies, spouses and collaborators support the aim as a matter of course. Assembling help is easy here.
aspects.spirit_trine_eris:
You can tell the truth and still be listened to.

Disruptive candour flows into chosen action, so naming the unwelcome thing advances the aim rather than costing you the room. Rarer than it sounds.
aspects.spirit_trine_eros:
You want to do what you decided on.

Desire reaches chosen action unobstructed, so appetite and intent point the same way and the work is pursued gladly. It is why long projects do not stall here.
aspects.spirit_trine_fortune:
What arrives and what you intended are usually the same thing.

The two lots flow together, so circumstance cooperates with deliberate action across a whole life. Genuine good fortune, and worth being honest with yourself that some of it was given.
aspects.spirit_trine_hygiea:
The way you work is sustainable, and you did not have to learn that.

Preventative care flows into deliberate action, so health and pace are built into the method. Nothing dramatic; a career that does not end in collapse.
aspects.spirit_trine_ic:
Home is where the work is resourced.

The base of the chart flows into chosen action, so family and private life quietly fund the purpose. The support is invisible from outside and load-bearing.
aspects.spirit_trine_juno:
Your commitments carry your purposes rather than constraining them.

Partnership flows into chosen action, so the alliance and the aim advance together. A spouse or collaborator is an asset to the work in the plainest sense.
aspects.spirit_trine_jupiter:
Your purposes grow without being forced.

Expansion pours into deliberate action, bringing scope, patronage and a rising trajectory to whatever you choose. Because nothing here demands effort, the talent can sit unused for decades.
aspects.spirit_trine_lilith:
Your refusals and your purposes are on the same side.

The disowned reaches deliberate action easily, so autonomy fuels the aim instead of disrupting it. What you will not do defines the work as usefully as what you will.
aspects.spirit_trine_mars:
Deciding and doing follow each other without a gap.

Drive arrives at the will unimpeded, so effort is well aimed and initiative costs nothing to summon. Competition suits you and does not distort the aim.
aspects.spirit_trine_mc:
Your work and your reputation build each other.

The career point reaches this lot unobstructed, so pursuing the aim raises your standing and the standing serves the aim. No trade-off to manage.
aspects.spirit_trine_mercury:
You can say exactly what you are aiming at.

Thought and this lot share a channel, so purpose is articulate, explicable and therefore easy for others to back. The clarity does much of the persuading for you.
aspects.spirit_trine_moon:
You know what you mean to do, and it feels right while you do it.

Instinct reaches deliberate action unobstructed, so emotional life and chosen direction agree, and the work is sustaining rather than depleting.
aspects.spirit_trine_neptune:
What you imagine and what you intend are the same thing.

Vision reaches the lot cleanly, so artistry and direction reinforce one another. Creative and devotional work is available without the usual struggle to make it practical.
aspects.spirit_trine_nessus:
You can work with damaged material without taking damage.

Inherited harm and deliberate action are at peace, so difficult histories become usable rather than contaminating. It suits work most people cannot do twice.
aspects.spirit_trine_north_node:
The direction you have chosen is the one you were going anyway.

The evolutionary path flows into the solar lot, so growth and deliberate effort proceed together without conflict. The luckiest configuration this lot can take.
aspects.spirit_trine_pallas:
The plan is good before you have finished making it.

Strategic intelligence reaches the purpose-point unobstructed, so design, timing and pattern come naturally to whatever you undertake. Rarely wrong-footed.
aspects.spirit_trine_pholus:
Small acts of yours open large doors, and mostly the right ones.

Catalysis flows into chosen action, so modest deliberate moves cascade in your favour. The leverage is real and worth using consciously rather than noticing afterwards.
aspects.spirit_trine_pluto:
You can go all the way down and come back with something.

Transformative depth flows into the will, so intensity is usable rather than overwhelming and the chosen work reaches the root of things. Formidable, and quietly so.
aspects.spirit_trine_saturn:
You finish what you start, and it holds.

Discipline underwrites purpose here, so structure and endurance come naturally rather than being extracted. The plainest description of a life that accumulates.
aspects.spirit_trine_south_node:
Everything you already knew how to do is useful to what you chose.

Inherited skill reaches chosen action cleanly, so past competence resources the present aim. Comfortable, and worth checking occasionally that it is not also limiting.
aspects.spirit_trine_sun:
Your purpose and your nature have never had to be reconciled.

Identity flows into the solar lot, so what you decide to do expresses who you are without translation. The ease is real and very easily taken for granted.
aspects.spirit_trine_uranus:
Originality serves the aim instead of competing with it.

Innovation flows into chosen action, so the unconventional route is also the effective one and reinvention does not cost continuity. An unusually adaptable purpose.
aspects.spirit_trine_venus:
The work is pleasant and that is not an accident.

Affection settles into chosen action, so what you pursue is agreeable, well-made and attracts willing company. It never demanded anything of you, which is both gift and catch.
aspects.spirit_trine_vesta:
Concentration is available whenever the work needs it.

Devotion reaches deliberate action easily, so focus arrives on request and leaves without a fight. The sustainable version of intensity.
aspects.spirit_quintile_sun:
You are good at being deliberate.

Identity and intent are set at the angle of a made skill, so choosing a direction is itself the thing you do well. It reads as confidence and is closer to practice.
aspects.spirit_quintile_moon:
You can shape a mood into a plan.

Feeling and purpose meet at a craftsman's angle, so what you want emotionally arrives already half-designed. The talent is in the translation, and it is easy to mistake for simply knowing your own mind.
aspects.spirit_quintile_mercury:
Your method is the talent.

Thinking and doing are joined by a knack for procedure - you find the order of operations other people miss. Explaining it afterwards is harder than doing it, which is the usual sign that a skill is real.
aspects.spirit_quintile_venus:
You have taste in what you undertake.

Purpose is shaped by an eye for proportion, so the projects you choose tend to be well-made rather than merely finished. Ugly work bothers you out of proportion to its consequences.
aspects.spirit_quintile_mars:
Effort comes out styled.

Drive and intent meet at an angle of skill rather than force, so you cut cleanly where others push. Speed is not the point and is often the result.
aspects.spirit_quintile_jupiter:
You are skilled at knowing what is worth doing.

Judgement about scale attaches to deliberate action, so you size an undertaking accurately before committing to it. The gift is in the declining as much as the taking on.
aspects.spirit_quintile_saturn:
You are good at building the thing that lasts.

Limit meets intent as a craft, so constraints read to you as design material rather than as obstruction. Given no constraints you will manufacture some.
aspects.spirit_quintile_uranus:
You have a talent for the sharp turn.

Disruption is joined to purpose by skill, so you change course cleanly instead of crashing out of things. Others experience it as sudden; for you it was worked out some time ago.
aspects.spirit_quintile_neptune:
You can make something out of a vague feeling.

Longing attaches to deliberate work as a technique, so what starts formless comes back with edges. The skill is real and does not make the original feeling reliable.
aspects.spirit_quintile_pluto:
You are skilled at applying pressure.

Buried force meets intent as craft rather than compulsion, so you know where a situation will give. Using it lightly is the whole discipline.
aspects.spirit_quintile_north_node:
Growth is something you have a knack for.

The unfamiliar direction is joined to purpose by skill, so you learn the new thing faster than the people who told you to try it. What you cannot do is want it on demand.
aspects.spirit_quintile_south_node:
Your inheritance turned into technique.

What was handed to you meets deliberate action as a made skill, so the old family competence gets used rather than merely carried. It is only a talent while you keep choosing it.
aspects.spirit_quintile_chiron:
You are good at working near the wound.

Injury and intent meet as craft, so you can do useful things in the place that hurt you without being disabled by it. Skill here is not the same as healing and is frequently mistaken for it.
aspects.spirit_quintile_ceres:
You have a talent for provision.

Feeding and purpose join as skill, so the care you offer is competent rather than merely willing. It is the practicality that people remember afterwards.
aspects.spirit_quintile_pallas:
Pattern is your working material.

Strategy and intent meet at an angle of pure skill, so you see the shape of a problem before you can justify it. The justification usually arrives, later, and is usually correct.
aspects.spirit_quintile_juno:
You are skilled at setting terms.

Commitment joins deliberate action as craft, so the agreements you make are unusually well-drafted. Living inside them is a separate ability.
aspects.spirit_quintile_vesta:
Concentration is the talent.

Devotion and purpose meet as a made skill, so you can hold a single thread far past the point where attention normally frays. It costs you the rest of the room.
aspects.spirit_quintile_eris:
You are good at being the objection.

Discord attaches to intent as a craft, so you can dissent without wrecking the table. The skill is in the timing, and it is why people tolerate it.
aspects.spirit_quintile_eros:
Desire comes out as workmanship.

Wanting and doing join at an angle of style, so appetite gets built into things rather than merely felt. It is the most reliable engine you own.
aspects.spirit_quintile_hygiea:
You have a talent for maintenance.

Prevention meets purpose as skill, so you keep the system running by small, well-judged interventions. Nobody notices this work, which is its nature and its cost.
aspects.spirit_quintile_nessus:
You are skilled at seeing the pattern before it closes.

Inherited harm and deliberate action meet as craft, so you recognise a cycle early enough to step out of it. Recognising it in others is easier and less useful.
aspects.spirit_quintile_pholus:
You have a feel for the small opening.

The minor cause with the large consequence joins your intent as skill, so you know which lid can be lifted. Knowing is not the same as having decided to.
aspects.spirit_quintile_fortune:
What arrives and what you intended are joined by skill.

The two lots meet at a craftsman's angle, so you are good at making use of circumstance rather than waiting on it. Luck looks like competence from outside and vice versa.
aspects.spirit_quintile_lilith:
Refusal is a skill you have.

The unassimilated part joins deliberate action as craft, so your no is well-made and lands where it should. It is why you are not easily conscripted.
aspects.spirit_quintile_ascendant:
Your manner is a made thing.

The rising degree and the lot of intent meet at an angle of skill, so how you present is designed rather than accidental. It is not insincere; it is rehearsed.
aspects.spirit_quintile_descendant:
You are skilled at choosing who to work with.

Partnership joins purpose as craft, so the people you attach to tend to be the right instrument for what you are doing. Choosing them for other reasons goes badly.
aspects.spirit_quintile_mc:
You have a talent for the public form of your work.

The visible aim and deliberate action meet as skill, so what you do translates into a career shape without much loss. The translation is the ability, not the ambition.
aspects.spirit_quintile_ic:
You are good at building the private ground.

Roots and intent meet at an angle of craft, so you can construct a base rather than inherit one. It is quiet work and it is what everything else stands on.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_sun:
Your purpose is carrying something older than you.

Identity and deliberate action meet on the inheritance angle, so what you set out to do is answering a family or ancestral account. It is why the work feels obligatory in a way your own reasons do not explain.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_moon:
You are working from an inherited memory.

The lot of intent bridges the ancestral floor and the public reach, so feeling supplies material you did not personally acquire. Your best work is other people's experience, correctly used.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_mercury:
You are the one who puts the family knowledge into words.

Thought joins deliberate action across the ancestral-to-philosophical span, so what was tacit for generations gets stated by you. Speaking it changes it, which is the cost of being the one who writes it down.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_venus:
Your taste is inherited and you are meant to publish it.

Value and intent bridge the fourth-house floor and the ninth-house reach, so what you find beautiful came down to you and is not finished until it is shared. Keeping it private is the only way to waste it.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_mars:
You fight an old fight on new ground.

Drive joins purpose across the inheritance angle, so the energy behind what you do was loaded before your lifetime. Winning it for yourself is not the assignment; ending it is.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_jupiter:
The inheritance wants a doctrine made of it.

Belief and deliberate action sit on the ancestral-to-universal bridge, so private family knowledge keeps demanding a general form. You are the one who has to argue for it in public.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_saturn:
You are completing an unfinished obligation.

Limit meets intent on the legacy angle, so the work has the weight of something owed backwards. The relief when a piece of it closes is out of proportion to the piece.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_uranus:
You break the line by carrying it forward.

Disruption joins purpose across the inheritance span, so what you pass on is the tradition altered past recognition. The family will not thank you and the work will outlast them.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_neptune:
You are dreaming something that was dreamt before you.

Longing and deliberate action bridge the ancestral floor and the collective reach, so the vision arrives with a fated quality and is not entirely yours. Attributing it to yourself is the one reliable way to lose it.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_pluto:
The buried thing wants to be published.

Compulsion joins intent on the legacy angle, so generational material presses to be brought up and given a public form. It will not settle for being understood privately.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_north_node:
The direction forward runs through what came before.

Growth meets deliberate action on the inheritance bridge, so the new thing is only reachable by going back through the old. Skipping the excavation produces a version that does not hold.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_south_node:
You are the one who gets to use the inheritance.

The lot of intent joins the ancestral point directly across the legacy angle, so a competence stored up for generations becomes usable in your hands. Refusing it is possible and unusually costly.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_chiron:
The family wound becomes the teaching.

Injury meets purpose on the ancestral-to-philosophical bridge, so what was inherited as damage is given back as instruction. This is not the same as being healed and it helps more people.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_ceres:
You feed the collective from an ancestral store.

Provision and deliberate action span the fourth-house floor and the ninth-house reach, so the way you sustain people comes from a lineage rather than a decision. It carries further than you plan for.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_pallas:
You inherited a way of seeing and it wants a public form.

Pattern joins intent on the legacy angle, so the perceptual gift running in the family reaches its usable shape in you. Systematising it is the work; having it is not.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_juno:
The terms you keep were set before you.

Commitment and deliberate action bridge ancestral ground and universal principle, so the loyalties you enact are older than the relationship enacting them. Examining them is worth more than honouring them.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_vesta:
You tend a flame that was handed on.

Devotion joins purpose across the inheritance span, so the thing you keep is held in trust rather than chosen. Handing it on is part of the tending and is easy to postpone forever.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_eris:
You carry the objection nobody in the family could make.

Discord meets intent on the legacy bridge, so the exclusion stored up in the line surfaces as your public argument. Speaking it is what you are for and it will cost you the room.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_eros:
The wanting has a lineage.

Desire joins deliberate action on the ancestral-to-collective angle, so appetite arrives already shaped by inherited patterns. Making something of it publicly is what stops it repeating privately.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_hygiea:
You inherited a way of keeping the body and are meant to teach it.

Maintenance meets purpose on the legacy bridge, so the health knowledge in your line is yours to formalise. It is small, unglamorous, and the part of the inheritance that actually saves people.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_nessus:
The cycle stops at you if it stops anywhere.

Inherited harm joins deliberate action across the ancestral angle, so the pattern arrives loaded and asking to be ended rather than passed. Naming it publicly is the mechanism, and it is not fair that this is your job.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_pholus:
One small act of yours releases several generations of pressure.

The minor trigger meets intent on the inheritance bridge, so what you do lightly opens something stored up long before. The scale of the consequence is never a mistake about the cause.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_fortune:
What was given and what you intend are the two ends of one inheritance.

The lots bridge the ancestral floor and the philosophical reach, so circumstance and choice both trace to the same source. The life reads as fated because in this narrow sense it is.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_lilith:
The exiled part of the lineage speaks through your work.

What the family would not assimilate joins your deliberate action on the legacy angle, so you give public form to the thing that was sent away. It is the most durable material you have.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_ascendant:
You arrive as the family's public face.

The rising degree meets the lot of intent across the inheritance span, so your manner announces a line and not only a person. People recognise something in you before they know what it is.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_descendant:
Partnership is where the inheritance gets handed over.

The other meets your purpose on the ancestral-to-universal bridge, so what you carry becomes transmissible in company. Alone, it stays a private family fact.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_mc:
Your public work is the legacy made visible.

The visible aim joins deliberate action across the inheritance angle, so the career is the form the ancestral material takes in the world. It explains why the ambition never felt entirely like yours.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquintile_ic:
The floor of the house is the source of the work.

Roots meet intent directly on the legacy bridge, so the private ground is not a retreat from the purpose but its material. Going home is research.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_sun:
The strain between who you are and what you chose stays out of sight until it goes off.

Identity and intent are joined by a friction you do not watch, so it accumulates as fatigue and irony rather than as an argument. When it finally surfaces it does so all at once and looks like a crisis of direction.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_moon:
You joke about the thing that is actually wearing you down.

Feeling crosses deliberate action at an angle too oblique to notice, so the discomfort is discharged as humour and stored as pressure. What eventually breaks is usually the body's patience rather than the plan.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_mercury:
The tension comes out as wit long before it comes out as truth.

Thought and purpose grind where you cannot see it, so the strain is spent on remarks. Very funny, entirely unresolved, and it builds.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_venus:
You will decide it is other people who have no taste.

Value and intent are set at a buried friction, so dissatisfaction with your own choices gets read as a fault in the company you keep. The correction, when it comes, is abrupt and directed at the wrong target.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_mars:
The anger is not where you think it is.

Drive crosses purpose out of sight, so the irritation attaches to whoever is nearest instead of to the misalignment causing it. It discharges suddenly and then looks disproportionate, because the cause was never named.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_jupiter:
The overreach is invisible until it is expensive.

Expansion and deliberate action rub below the level you monitor, so plans inflate quietly and correct violently. You will describe the correction as bad luck.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_saturn:
Obligation grinds where nobody can see it and then gives way at once.

Limit meets intent at a hidden friction, so duty is absorbed for years without complaint. The refusal, when it arrives, is sudden, total and surprises everyone including you.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_uranus:
The break comes from the quarter you never watch.

Independence crosses purpose obliquely, so pressure for change builds where you are not looking and releases without notice. You will call it sudden; it was under way for a long time.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_neptune:
You will blame the circumstances rather than the drift.

Longing and intent chafe out of sight, so the loss of definition gets projected outward as other people being unclear. The reckoning comes when the aim can no longer be stated at all.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_pluto:
Something buried is loading, and it is not going to leak.

Compulsion crosses deliberate action beneath the visible level, so the pressure builds in one narrow place. It does not release gradually; it releases completely.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_north_node:
You resist the growth by mocking it.

The unfamiliar direction grinds against purpose where you do not look, so the discomfort is disposed of as scepticism. It works until the situation forces the change anyway.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_south_node:
The old habit undermines the new intent from underneath.

Inheritance crosses deliberate action out of sight, so the practiced response quietly wins for years. What ends it is a rupture rather than a decision.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_chiron:
The sore place is nowhere in your account of the problem.

Injury and purpose grind below awareness, so the interference is projected onto colleagues, timing, conditions - anything external. It surfaces as a sudden inability to continue.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_ceres:
You will feel unappreciated before you notice you are depleted.

Provision crosses intent at a hidden friction, so the cost of caring accumulates unlogged and comes out as a grievance about others. The eventual withdrawal is abrupt and reads as cold.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_pallas:
You can see the flaw in everyone's plan except the one you are inside.

Pattern meets deliberate action out of view, so the strategic tension is exported as criticism. The insight is real; the location is wrong.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_juno:
The friction gets attributed to your partner.

Commitment crosses purpose where neither of you looks, so a structural strain in the agreement is experienced as the other person's character. It comes to a head suddenly and about something small.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_vesta:
The devotion and the aim part company without telling you.

Focus grinds against intent below the surface, so you concentrate faithfully on something that stopped serving the purpose. Discovering it is not gradual.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_eris:
You are funny about the exclusion rather than direct about it.

Discord crosses deliberate action out of sight, so the grievance is spent on sharp remarks and stored rather than settled. When it does surface it takes the whole table with it.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_eros:
The appetite is doing more damage than you have accounted for.

Desire meets purpose at a buried friction, so the disturbance is rationalised or laughed off while it accumulates. The disruption, when it lands, is sudden and reorganises the plan.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_hygiea:
The upkeep you keep deferring is the pressure.

Maintenance crosses intent below notice, so small neglects compound silently in one narrow place. The correction is forced rather than chosen and it arrives as an event.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_nessus:
The old pattern is running underneath the work and you are calling it other people.

Inherited harm crosses purpose out of sight, so the interference is projected onto whoever is in the room. It breaks the surface abruptly, usually in a relationship rather than in the work.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_pholus:
The small thing is not small, and you will find out quickly.

The minor trigger grinds against deliberate action out of view, so pressure gathers behind something that looked trivial. It releases all at once and the size of it is never a mistake.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_fortune:
What arrives and what you meant are out of register, and neither gets blamed.

The two lots grind below the level you examine, so the mismatch runs for years disguised as bad timing. When it surfaces, it does so as a single decisive break.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_lilith:
The refusal is buried and it is not negotiable.

What you will not assimilate crosses your purpose out of sight, so the resistance is denied, joked about, or read into other people. It ends the arrangement abruptly when it finally speaks.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_ascendant:
Your manner is doing damage you never see, because you are behind it.

The rising degree grinds against the lot of intent from a blind angle, so the cost lands on other people and returns to you much later, all at once.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_descendant:
The strain in the partnership is treated as the partner.

The other crosses your purpose out of sight, so a structural friction gets read as their personality. It builds without discussion and resolves by rupture.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_mc:
The public form of the work is quietly at odds with why you started.

The visible aim grinds against deliberate action where nobody audits it, so small compromises stack for years. The departure, when it comes, is sudden and is described as burnout.
aspects.spirit_sesquiquadrate_ic:
Home is applying a pressure that never gets named.

Roots cross intent beneath the level of discussion, so the private ground works against the chosen direction unlogged. It surfaces late, as a single decision that looks unprovoked.
